problem: LLM guardrails are vulnerable to spatially-structured perturbations that allow harmful content to bypass output safety mechanisms.
approach: SpatialJB exploits the Transformer's spatial weakness by disrupting output generation with structured tokens to bypass guardrails without detection.
contribution: Achieves nearly 100% attack success rate on leading LLMs and maintains >75% success against advanced guardrails like OpenAI Moderation API.

problem: Decentralized multi-agent RL faces tension between exploration bonuses and coordination consistency over communication graphs.
approach: IEC couples exploration and coordination through a single constrained objective using information gain and state-coverage novelty with spectral smoothness penalty on neighbors, optimized via primal-dual updates.
contribution: Achieves superior performance across three benchmarks with automatic shift from exploration to stable cooperative conventions.

problem: Active regression for single-index models with unknown Lipschitz link functions under general p-norm loss remains challenging.
approach: Present non-adaptive sampling algorithm achieving (1+epsilon)-approximation with query complexity O(d^(p/2 v 1) / epsilon^(p v 2) polylog(n/epsilon)); establish nearly tight lower bounds for p>2.
contribution: Closes remaining gaps in active ell-p regression theory for single-index models with unknown link functions.

problem: Deep learning models for MS/HS fusion are designed for fixed spectral bands and spatial scales, limiting transferability across sensors.
approach: SSA uses Matryoshka Kernel enabling variable spectral band processing and Implicit Neural Representation backbone for arbitrary spatial resolution reconstruction.
contribution: Single model achieves SOTA, generalizes to unseen scales, and transfers to unseen sensors with few-step adaptation.

problem: Single fixed discount factor limits RL performance by failing to balance short-term and long-term planning in complex tasks.
approach: Multi-timescale critic framework with distinct discount factors for each Q-value component; Neural Reward Decoder reconstructs reward sequences and cross-attention Q-weight predictor adapts weights.
contribution: Significantly outperforms SOTA on DMControl and CARLA; works with both off-policy (SAC, DrQ-v2) and on-policy (PPO) algorithms.

problem: Test-time scaling methods allocate same compute budget per prompt despite varying complexity, leading to inefficiency.
approach: EAGer uses token-wise entropy distribution to branch only on high-entropy tokens and reallocate saved compute to instances needing exploration.
contribution: Achieves up to +37% Pass@k and 59% fewer tokens with labels; +12% Pass@k and 64% fewer tokens in test-time setting on reasoning benchmarks.

problem: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation is limited by CLIP's spatial bias and semantic ambiguity in text queries.
approach: VIP rectifies semantic expressiveness using visual-guided prompt evolution with alias expansion and visual-guided distillation aggregated in saliency-aware manner.
contribution: Surpasses top methods by 1.4-8.4% mIoU, generalizes to diverse domains, requires marginal inference overhead.

problem: Existing representation similarity metrics lack interpretability, robustness to outliers, and computational efficiency for large datasets.
approach: Develop ordinal-similarity framework using Triplet and Quadruplet Similarity Indices measuring alignment via ordinal relationship consistency.
contribution: Framework is interpretable, robust, computationally efficient; establishes equivalence to local neighborhood alignment via Mutual Nearest Neighbors.

problem: Performative learning where distribution reacts to deployed model needs to account for unknown distribution shifts caused by strategic users.
approach: Study regularization impact in high-dimensional ridge regression under performative effects; show optimal regularization scales with performative effect strength.
contribution: Demonstrates in over-parameterized regime, performativity enables reduced variance via optimal regularization, improving performance.

problem: Large audio language models expanded attack surface for jailbreak vulnerabilities.
approach: Acoustic Interference Attack leverages acoustic latent semantics to create universal jailbreak triggers that interfere with safety alignment without semantic payload.
contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art attack success rate across 10 LALMs and identifies fundamental vulnerability in cross-modal alignment.

problem: RL algorithms like GRPO use coarse-grained credit assignment where all tokens receive same reward, limiting reasoning improvement.
approach: GTPO assigns entropy-weighted reward to each token and synthesizes token-specific advantage functions; GRPO-S applies same design at sequence level.
contribution: Establishes SOTA on AIME and MATH 500, outperforming prior entropy-guided baselines.

problem: Naive continual distillation in frontier regime yields limited gains or degradation as training bottlenecks stifle yet-to-learn tokens.
approach: T3S reconstructs training objective at token level via training-trajectory-aware selection, separating imitation-anchor tokens from yet-to-learn tokens.
contribution: Qwen3-8B surpasses DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3-32B approaches Qwen3-235B, LLaDA-2.0-Mini exceeds baseline, all SOTA among 16B-scale no-think models.

approach: Develop weighted Hilbert-space framework L^2(lambda; R^d) showing row-stochastic becomes self-adjoint while doubly stochastic doesn't, creating penalty terms amplifying consensus error.
